title: Scientists Name a Giant Fungus “D-rex”
paragraphs: Scientists in China have named a new fungus. Its full name is Dianjunus rex, but people call it “D-rex”. It grows in the forests of Yunnan, in southern China, on dead wood and tree roots.

The visible part of the fungus can grow up to 50 centimetres tall and weigh up to 2.2 kilograms. That is taller than any other known fungus in its big group, which is called Ascomycota. The old record was only 20 to 30 centimetres.
The team also says it belongs to a new family. Using DNA, they think this family is about 65 million years old. The scientists are not sure why the fungus grows so tall.
